Use numbered equation environments. • Discussion: the condition '0<m_f≤(1-2ε)^{-1}' appears there but nowhere in \cref{obj:thm:k-label-rate} or \cref{obj:def:score-lower-density-class}. Either add it to the definition as the nonemptiness condition or remove it from the Discussion. • \cref{obj:ass:density-lower} does not require m_f>0, yet the text after it says 'when the floor is positive'. \cref{obj:def:score-lower-density-class} is also phrased as 'Under \cref{obj:ass:density-lower}', which is circular for a class definition. Define the class directly with m_f>0. • \cref{obj:ass:overlap} only constrains ε, yet the text says it 'keeps both assignment probabilities positive throughout the score space'. Make the support restriction E∈[ε,1−ε] part of the assumption, or say explicitly that positivity comes from the score space together with \cref{obj:ass:randomized-assignment}. • Section 3 opening: 'Arm and label indices range over the sets defined below' and 'absolute values and Euclidean norms have their usual meanings' assert nothing usable. Delete them. • Appendix: '\section*{Appendices}' is immediately followed by '\section{Proofs and verification scope}', which is a redundant heading. Remove the starred heading. • Verification scope subsection: it says Fan–Sherman–Shum is 'used as a cited input' for \cref{obj:lem:fixed-released-law-baseline}, yet that lemma has a full self-contained proof in the appendix. Clarify which part of the lemma rests on the citation. • The constant $C_{\varepsilon,J,\alpha,g}$ in \cref{obj:thm:external-score-root-order} is explicitly independent of g; the proof formula depends only on ε, J and α. Drop g from the subscript. • The independence assumptions (\cref{obj:ass:external-log-iid,obj:ass:external-log-independent}) are motivated by citing \citep{MarellaPfeffermann2019} as a 'standard' condition, a paper on informative sampling. Cite a general two-sample data-combination source or give a direct justification. • Section 6, last sentence: 'The matching lower bound makes this balance a property of the experiment, rather than of the particular interval construction' is contrastive framing. Rewrite it affirmatively: 'The matching lower bound shows that this balance holds for every honest procedure.' • Introduction: the sentence beginning “An asymptotically attaining sequence places interval boundaries” contains corrupted characters in the weight formula and the following definitions of f and e. Restore the LaTeX and proofread the rendered sentence. • The ATE is called “the average treatment effect θ(P)” in the trial setup, but its defining environment appears in the later inference section. Move the definition to the setup and cite it at subsequent named uses. • “For a probability law F” defines generalized quantiles after the mean-endpoint formulas already use Q. Move the quantile definition before those formulas. • The universal point-identification theorem begins “Let J∈ℕ” while its label alphabet was defined for positive J. State J≥1 consistently. • The high-resolution theorem specifies g_K with labels {0,…,K−1}, while the K-label release class uses {1,…,K}. Relabel the constructed release or explicitly identify the two alphabets. • Interval length appears as “len”, “length”, and “|C_n|” without a stated convention. Define one notation and use it throughout. • The external projection definition says “a real number α” and uses 1/α in its radii. State the admissible level and positive sample sizes in that definition. • The projection construction calls rational, nonnegative weights “nonnegative extended-real numbers.” Remove “extended-real” or explain why infinite weights are permitted in finite measures. • The projection construction says “let I(b) be the interval given by its two quantile-transport average treatment effect endpoints” without giving the endpoint rule for a candidate array. Supply the formula or an exact cross-reference that applies to those arrays. • The branch “For other values of ε, set D_{ε,J}=∅” appears inside an analysis that assumes 0<ε<1/2. Remove this formal totalization branch from the reader-facing procedure. • The appendix defines a “High-resolution handle” as an “uncrossing or intervalization result ... followed by local ... arguments,” but states no usable result and never uses the named object. Delete this definition and explain the actual argument where needed. • “Certificate” and “lower certificates” recur in the external-log appendix as formalization jargon. Replace them with “lower-bound argument” or the specific statistical construction. • The high-resolution proof includes “At K=0, assign zero to the two auxiliary scaled quantities” although the theorem and release construction concern positive K. Remove this extraneous case. • The author footnote says the verification appendix records “scope, toolchain, commit,” but the “Verification scope” subsection contains no toolchain or commit. Add the promised metadata or revise the footnote to match the appendix. • Several external-source citations lack the locators required by the paper’s citation contract, including later general references to FanShermanShum2014 in the setup and appendix. Add accurate section, theorem, equation, assumption, or page locators where those citations support specific claims. • After defining external honest procedures, “Membership in J^{ext}_{n,m,α}(g) requires coverage for every admissible score law and causal law” merely repeats the display. Replace it with an implication useful for interpreting the criterion or remove it. • The mean-endpoint formulas are reproduced in their definition, the all-label theorem, and the fixed-law lemma. Keep the defining display and refer back to it where repetition adds no new condition.
